question: Which records on this object belong to inactive users?

steps.name: records
steps.soql: SELECT Id, OwnerId, Owner.Name, LastModifiedDate FROM {obj} WHERE OwnerId IN (SELECT Id FROM User WHERE IsActive = false) ORDER BY LastModifiedDate DESC LIMIT {limit}

verdicts.say: {records.rows} row(s) returned by the first query. Review selected columns, query limits and follow-up steps; this is not an org-wide assessment.

traps: The selected object must support OwnerId and LastModifiedDate. Queue ownership is excluded.
Visibility and the query limit constrain results. Inactive ownership is not proof the record is abandoned.
